translations.web: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.
translations.bsb: You, O king, are the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given sovereignty, power, strength, and glory.
translations.kjv: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
